title: Initialize Data Structures
description: Create a queue to manage node exploration order. Initialize visited set/dict to track discovered nodes. Set distance of source node to 0 and mark it as visited. Enqueue the source node.

title: Dequeue Current Node
description: Remove the front node from the queue. This is the current node being processed. Its distance from the source is the minimum possible (shortest path property).

title: Explore Neighbors
description: For each neighbor of the current node: if it has NOT been visited, mark it as visited, set its distance = current_distance + 1, and enqueue it. If it IS already visited, skip it (already discovered via a shorter or equal path).

title: Process Current Node
description: Perform any desired operation on the current node (record it, check if it's the target, etc.). This is where application-specific logic typically goes.

title: Repeat Until Queue Empty
description: Continue dequeuing and processing nodes until the queue is empty. When the queue is empty, all nodes reachable from the source have been discovered and their shortest distances are known.
